 Profile 2: QA - Collection ( Job Code # 242 )

 Quality Assurance in B2B Collections is the process of monitoring, evaluating, and improving collection calls, customer interactions, and dispute resolution activities to ensure compliance with quality standards, collection policies, and client-defined KPIs and SLAs.

 Strong understanding of B2B Collections, Dispute Management, and Quality Assurance processes. Conduct regular call monitoring, transaction audits, and quality evaluations. Ensure adherence to Collections KPIs, SLAs, quality standards, and client-defined targets. Evaluate agents on communication skills, negotiation techniques, customer handling, and process compliance. Monitor Promise-to-Pay (PTP), payment follow-ups, invoice disputes, and collection procedures. Identify quality gaps and provide regular feedback and coaching to improve agent performance. Conduct quality calibration sessions with Operations, Training, and Team Leaders. Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and recommend corrective actions for recurring quality issues. Review customer escalations, collection disputes, and compliance deviations. Support Team Leaders in improving low-performing and outlier agents. Maintain quality scorecards, audit reports, performance trackers, and dashboards. Analyze quality trends and identify opportunities for process improvement and operational efficiency. Ensure compliance with client policies, collection guidelines, and data confidentiality standards. Communicate quality concerns and process deviations to internal and external stakeholders. Prepare weekly and monthly quality reports highlighting performance, improvement areas, and corrective action plans. 
 Profile 3: Team Lead - Collection ( Job Code # 243 ) 
 Team Lead Collection , supervises, and motivates a team of Collections and Recovery Executives to achieve financial recovery targets, reduce overdue payments, control delinquency, and ensure efficient collection operations. 
 Key Skills: 
 Minimum 3 years of experience in B2B / OTC Collections . At least 1 year of Team Handling experience Any Graduate

 Complete and thorough understanding of B2B Collections work modalities and requirements. Understanding of all Collections KPIs, SLAs, performance reports, and tools, with the ability to implement them across Collections and Dispute Management. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Oversee the team and ensure smooth daily Business as Usual (BAU) operations. Manage day-to-day operational functions, team management, and performance delivery. Review and resolve operational issues. Ensure achievement of KPIs and client-defined targets. Conduct floor training and coaching sessions. Provide quality feedback to team members to improve performance. Perform quality evaluations and provide regular coaching and performance feedback. Drive process improvements and increase operational efficiency. Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders. Analyze performance reports and identify areas for improvement. Work effectively in a target-oriented Collections environment. Manage teams and operations in a Contact Centre Collections environment. Demonstrate a good understanding of quality tools and methodologies. Manage shrinkage, absenteeism, and attrition. Provide support and performance management for outlier agents. Demonstrate strong communication and interpersonal skills. Proactively communicate process exceptions, deviations, and operational bottlenecks to managers and relevant stakeholders. Prepare weekly and monthly performance presentations highlighting achievements, improvement areas, and corrective action plans.
